description: This file defines the ShapeAttributeBindingStrategy class, which implements shape binding logic for OrchardCore's display management, including discovering shape attributes, creating delegates for rendering, and binding shape methods to the shape table.

classes.name: ShapeAttributeBindingStrategy
classes.description: Implements shape attribute binding and discovery for OrchardCore display management.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Discovers shape attributes and binds shape methods to the shape table.

methods.name: CreateDelegate
methods.description: Creates a delegate for rendering a shape method based on its attribute occurrence.

methods.name: CreateMethodWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a method into a delegate that can be invoked dynamically.

methods.name: CreateParamsExpressions
methods.description: Creates expression trees for method parameters.

methods.name: BindParameter
methods.description: Binds method parameters to context properties or services.

methods.name: MakeHtmlHelper
methods.description: Creates an IHtmlHelper instance for rendering HTML content.
